thread:
jess: Heads-up — had the most chaotic 2pm: my mic turned into a cave echo mid-demo and then the Roomba started a solo set. :face_with_thermometer: Quick poll: what cheap mic setup actually fixes echo for calls? USB shotgun vs Blue Yeti vs XLR+interface vs something else? Also any quick echo-kill tricks?

samira: If you can swing a small budget, get an XLR dynamic (Shure SM58/SM7 style) + Focusrite. Much less room noise. For tight budgets: Samson Q2U (USB/XLR) is solid.

maya: Yeti works ok if you dial gain down and use cardioid. Also put a blanket behind you and a rug under the desk — cheap acoustics. :raised_hands:

omar: I swear by a USB shotgun pointing at mouth, makes background less obvious. But it's bulky.

sys-op: Pro tips: 1) Zoom/Teams: Settings -> Audio -> Suppress background noise = High. 2) Move mic closer, lower gain. 3) Consider push-to-talk for demos if someone's vacuuming.

jess: lol the push-to-talk would have saved me — had to mime for 30s. Anyone got a quick link to a cheap 2-pack acoustic panel or blanket suggestion?

samira: https://example.com/cheap-acoustic-2pack — not perfect but better than bare drywall. Also Velcro to hang behind monitors.

maya: Poll (react with emoji): :one: USB shotgun, :two: Blue Yeti, :three: XLR+interface, :four: Q2U/cheap dynamic

omar: :two: for me (Yeti) — simple plug-and-play.

samira: :three: from me. Worth the extra setup.

jess: Voting :four: — picked up a Q2U last week and it tamed my echo for cheap. Thanks everyone. :heart:

dev-bot: NOTE: noise-detection event logged in #random (Roomba) at system time. :robot_face:

maya: follow-up: if demo is critical, toss a little sign on door that says "Recording in progress" or bribe housemates with snacks. Less dramatic than muting.

jess: Good call. Next demo I'll have snacks ready and a "do not vacuum" sticky note on the Roomba. :yum: Thanks all — saved these tips.
